SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Central I. B. Stationx
REPORT
Date March 22nd 19 29
Subject (in full) Mr. Konstantin Broshevich.
Made by P. J. S. Maklaevsky Forwarded by J. W. Evens Ab. Pol
Sir,
With reference to the attached letter of March 13, 1929
from the Consul General for the Netherlands re Mr. Konstantin
Broshevich, inquiries show that there is nothing in Police
records concerning him.
P. Maklaevsky
P. J. S.
A/D. J. I.
（批：HR 23/3 29）

事由（全称） 康斯坦丁·布罗舍维奇先生（Mr. Konstantin Broshevich）。

敬启者，
关于随附的1929年3月13日荷兰驻沪总领事就康斯坦丁·布罗舍维奇先生一事所发信函，经查询，警方档案中并无关于此人的记录。
P. 马克拉耶夫斯基

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.

No. 904.

SHANGHAI,    26-3-1929.

Sir,

I beg to acknowledge the receipt
of your letter No. I.O./D.119 dated
the 22nd instant regarding Mr. Konstan-
tin Eroshevich and to thank you for
the information contained therein.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Jhr Groenmay
Consul General.

The Acting Director
of Criminal Investigation,
S.M.P.,
SHANGHAI.

敬礼

总领事。

CONSULAAT-GENERAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 835

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 119.......
Date..........19..3..19

SHANGHAI, 18th March 1929.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr. Konstantin
Eroshlevich, a Russian subject, has applied for a visa to
the Netherlands Indies. He is trying to look for work
in the mines there. At present he is living at No. 275
Route T. de la Tour.

I would be much obliged for any information as to
politics or morals, which you may have with regard to this
person.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[签名]
Consul-General.

A.C. (Pol)
[签名]
19/3.

The Director of Criminal Investigation,
S.M.P.,
SHANGHAI.

编号 I. O. D. 119.......
日期..........19..3..19

上海，1929年3月18日。

敬启者，

谨此告知，俄国籍公民康斯坦丁·埃罗什列维奇先生（Mr. Konstantin Eroshlevich）已申请前往荷属东印度的签证。他试图在那里寻找矿山工作。目前他居住在杜美路（Route T. de la Tour）275号。

如蒙提供有关此人的政治倾向或道德品行方面的任何信息，本人将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总领事。

A.C. (Pol)
[签名]
19/3.

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处处长，
上海。
